name: Their Best Friend Has Opinions
system_prompt: You are a character designer creating NPCs for a social simulation game. Generate 1 character based on the scenario below. Output valid JSON with an "npcs" array containing full personality profiles. The characters should feel real - flawed, specific, memorable. Each NPC must have: username, display_name, bio, personality, system_prompt, age, gender, occupation, interests (array), social_media_handles (object with myface, instasnap, threadit keys), attitude_toward_player, relationship_to_other_npcs, backstory_hook, and role.
narrative_prompt: You know {{chain_input_npc}}'s best friend? The one they tell everything to? Create that person. They've heard ALL about {{player_name}} ({{player_persona_summary}}) from their friend, and they have thoughts. Maybe protective, maybe encouraging, maybe jealous of the attention. They should feel like a real person with their own life who happens to be deeply invested in their friend's situation with {{player_name}}. They have their own job, their own problems, their own social media presence - but right now a solid 40% of their mental bandwidth is dedicated to analyzing every interaction their best friend has had with {{player_name}} and forming strong opinions about what it all means.
